acceptanceCriteria: Profile evidence shows fewer intent-tree passes per read command with the SNAPSHOT_MOVED counterexamples unchanged.
body:
## Observation

Found while fixing GitHub 446. With a usable checkpoint `queue status` takes about 0.25 s on this store (860 canonical paths). A CPU profile attributes nearly all of it to `snapshot.Reader.Read`: the outer probe computes `intent.TreeDigest` before and after, `intent.LoadExpecting` reads the tree again, and the journal capture digests it twice more. Cost is now proportional to the intent tree, not to receipt history.

## Request

Share one intent-tree observation between the outer snapshot probe and the journal capture, without weakening the two-capture movement check.
